description: KNaP₆(PbO₃)₈ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-2.89 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.45 Å) and three longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.80 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.73 Å. In the third Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.44 Å. In the fourth Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Pb-O bond lengths are 2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one PbO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent PbO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Pb and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, two Pb, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pb, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, two Pb, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one K, one Pb, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pb, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Pb and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Pb and one P atom.
